{{nihongo|'''Tōchi no Miagata Nimasu Shrine'''|十市御縣坐神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Tōchi no Miagata Nimasu Shrine''' (とおちのみあがたにますじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Kashihara, Nara|ar|كاشيهارا (نارا)|azb|کاشیهارا، نارا|ca|Kashihara|ce|Касихара|ceb|Kashihara-shi (lungsod sa Hapon)|cs|Kašihara|de|Kashihara|eo|Kaŝihara|es|Kashihara (Nara)|eu|Kashihara (Nara)|fa|کاشیهارا، نارا|fi|Kashihara|fr|Kashihara|gl|Kashihara|hy|Կաշիհարա|id|Kashihara, Nara|it|Kashihara|ja|橿原市|ko|가시하라시|ms|Kashihara, Nara|mzn|کاشیهارا، نارا|nl|Kashihara|no|Kashihara|pl|Kashihara|pt|Kashihara|ro|Kashihara|ru|Касихара|sh|Kashihara|simple|Kashihara, Nara|sr|Кашихара|sv|Kashihara|tg|Кашиҳара|th|คาชิฮาระ|tl|Kashihara, Nara|tr|Kashihara|tt|Касихара|uk|Касіхара|ur|کاشی ہارا، نارا|vi|Kashihara, Nara|war|Kashihara, Nara|zh|橿原市|zh_classical|橿原市|zh_min_nan|Kasihara-chhī|zh_yue|橿原|qid=Q496319}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. The ''Great Yamato Province Tax Register'' of {{ill|730|Q23563|qid=Q23563}} ({{ill|Tenpyō|Q1199879|qid=Q1199879}} 3; {{ill|Shōsōin Documents|Q11545362|qid=Q11545362}}) records “Tōichi Mikata Kōbe,” showing it is an ancient shrine continuing from before the {{ill|Nara period|Q189178|qid=Q189178}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinai Taisha|Q134917288|qid=Q134917288}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
*Main deity: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Toyouke Ōkami}}
*Associated deity: {{ill|Ichikishima-hime|qid=Q11059454|lt=Ichikishimahime-no-Mikoto}}
**According to shrine tradition, the deity is '''{{ill|Toichi no Agatanushi Ōme|Q97496325|qid=Q97496325|lt=Ōme}}''', ancestor of the Tōichi Agatanushi seen in the ''{{ill|Emperor Kōrei|ar|الإمبراطور كوريه|arz|الامبراطور كوريه|azb|کوریه (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Kōrei|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر کۆرێی|cs|Kórei|de|Kōrei|es|Kōrei Tennō|fa|امپراتور کوریه|fi|Kōrei|fr|Kōrei|he|קוריי, קיסר יפן|hr|Kōrei|id|Kaisar Kōrei|it|Kōrei|ja|孝霊天皇|ka|კორეი|ko|고레이 천황|nl|Korei|pl|Kōrei|pt|Korei|ro|Împăratul Kōrei|ru|Император Корэй|sh|Car Kōrei|simple|Emperor Kōrei|sl|Cesar Korej|sr|Кореи|sv|Korei|th|จักรพรรดิโคเร|tl|Emperador Korei|tr|Kōrei (imparator)|uk|Імператор Корей|uz|Imperator Kōrei|vi|Thiên hoàng Kōrei|zh|孝靈天皇|zh_classical|孝靈天皇|zh_min_nan|Kôrei Thian-hông|zh_yue|孝靈天皇|qid=Q313041}}''. Isasaka-hime, daughter of Tōichi Agatanushi Isasakahiko, was {{ill|Emperor Kōan|Q312821|qid=Q312821}}’s {{ill|Empress consort|Q7723211|qid=Q7723211}}; and {{ill|Kuwashi-hime|Q11605816|qid=Q11605816}}, daughter of Ōme, was Empress of Emperor Kōrei.

=== History ===
The founding date is unknown, but it is an ancient shrine listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}''. Since ancient times it was {{ill|Imperial House of Japan|ar|البيت الإمبراطوري في اليابان|as|জাপানৰ ৰাজপৰিয়াল|ast|Familia imperial xaponesa|az|Yaponiya imperator evi|be|Імператарскі дом Японіі|ca|Família Imperial del Japó|ckb|خێزانی شاھانەی ژاپۆن|cs|Japonská císařská dynastie|de|Japanisches Kaiserhaus|el|Αυτοκρατορικός Οίκος της Ιαπωνίας|eo|Japana reĝa familio|es|Familia imperial japonesa|fa|دودمان یاماتو|fr|Maison impériale du Japon|he|בית הקיסרות של יפן|hr|Japanska carska obitelj|hu|Japán császári ház|id|Wangsa Kekaisaran Jepang|it|Famiglia imperiale del Giappone|ja|皇室|ko|일본 황실|la|Domus imperatoriae Iaponiae|ms|Kerabat diraja Jepun|no|Japans keiserhus|pt|Casa Imperial do Japão|ro|Familia imperială a Japoniei|ru|Японский императорский дом|sh|Carska kuća Japana|simple|Imperial House of Japan|sq|Shtëpia Perandorake e Japonisë|th|ราชวงศ์ญี่ปุ่น|tr|Yamato Hanedanı|uk|Імператорський дім Японії|ur|جاپان کا شاہی خاندان|vi|Hoàng thất Nhật Bản|zh|日本皇室|zh_classical|日本皇室|zh_min_nan|Ji̍t-pún hông-sek|zh_yue|日本皇室|qid=Q909452}} {{ill|imperial property|Q11581043|qid=Q11581043|lt=land}}, and worshiped the spirit of sacred vegetable gardens used to cultivate {{ill|Olericulture|Q952624|qid=Q952624}} offered to the {{ill|Emperor of Japan|Q208233|qid=Q208233}}. Together with Takachi, Katsuraki, Tōichi, Shiki, Yamabe, and Sofu, it was one of the “{{ill|The Six Prefectures of Wa|Q55521849|qid=Q55521849|lt=Six Mikata Shrines of Yamato Province}},” deeply revered by the imperial court. On {{ill|January 27 (Lunisolar)|Q839032|qid=Q839032|lt=January 27}}, {{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}} ({{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611}} 3), its {{ill|Shinkai (divine rank)|Q11591025|qid=Q11591025}} rose to {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|Q11071125|qid=Q11071125}} and shrine households were allotted. In the reign of {{ill|Emperor Daigo|Q329753|qid=Q329753}}, under the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engi system}}, it was listed as a {{ill|Taisha (shrine)|Q11438310|qid=Q11438310}} and received official offerings at the Kinen, Tsukinami, and Niiname rites. In the {{ill|Edo period|ar|فترة إيدو|ast|Periodu Edo|az|Edo dövrü|bcl|Panahon nin Edo|be|Перыяд Эда|bg|Едо (период)|bn|এদো যুগ|bo|ཨེ་དོའི་དུས་སྐབས།|br|Marevezh Edo|ca|Període Edo|ckb|سەردەمی ئێدۆ|cs|Období Edo|cv|Эдо тапхăрĕ|da|Edo-perioden|de|Edo-Zeit|eo|Epoko de Edo|es|Período Edo|et|Edo ajastu|eu|Edo aroa|fa|دوره ادو|fi|Edo-kausi|fr|Époque d'Edo|gl|Período Edo|he|תקופת אדו|hi|एदो अवधी|hr|Edo (razdoblje)|hu|Edo-kor|id|Zaman Edo|is|Jedótímabilið|it|Periodo Edo|ja|江戸時代|jv|Jaman Édo|ko|에도 시대|lt|Edo laikotarpis|lv|Edo periods|mk|Едо (период)|mn|Эдогийн эрин|ms|Zaman Edo|nl|Edoperiode|nn|Edotida|oc|Periòde Edo|pl|Edo (okres)|pt|Período Edo|ro|Perioada Edo|ru|Период Эдо|simple|Edo period|sk|Obdobie Edo|sl|Obdobje Edo|sq|Periudha Edo|sr|Едо период|su|Période Edo|sv|Edoperioden|th|ยุคเอโดะ|tl|Panahong Edo|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Eto|tr|Edo Dönemi|uk|Період Едо|ur|ایڈو دور|uz|Edo davri|vi|Thời kỳ Edo|war|Panahon Edo|wuu|江戶時代|zh|江户时代|zh_min_nan|Edo sî-tāi|zh_yue|江戶時代|qid=Q184963}} it was also called “Jūsansho (Jūsasho) Daimyōjin,” but was identified with the Engishiki “Tōichi Mikata-ni-masu Shrine.”
